bind_url.description: Base URL of the BIND server (e.g., http://localhost or https://dns.example.com)

bind_port.description: Port of BIND’s XML statistics channel (default 8053 for XML v3, or 9547 for older versions)

bind_path.description: Path to the BIND XML statistics endpoint. Common: /xml/v3/statistics or /xml/v2/statistics

bind_use_tls.description: Whether to use TLS/HTTPS when connecting to the BIND stats channel

bind_username.description: Username for HTTP Basic Auth (if BIND stats channel is protected)

bind_password.description: Password for HTTP Basic Auth (if BIND stats channel is protected)

bind_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for HTTP requests to BIND stats channel

log_level.description: Log verbosity level (debug, info, warn, error)

extra_labels.description: List of key=value label pairs to attach to all exported metrics (e.g., ["env=prod", "team=network"])

views.description: If set, only scrape metrics for these named views (e.g., ["internal", "external"]). Leave empty to scrape all views.

disable_metrics.description: List of metric categories to disable (e.g., ["queries", "resolver", "zones"]). Check exporter docs for valid options.
